modules.modulesHint: A module that is off hides its screens from the sidebar and the search palette, and the server rejects its operations. Turning one on requires its parent module; turning it off also turns off the ones that depend on it. Changing a module asks you to confirm your identity (reauthentication) if you have not done so recently.

modules.loadError: The module list could not be read.

ops.clientLabelsDefault: Print labels automatically for new clients
ops.clientLabelsDefaultHelp: It is the value each new client starts with; afterwards it is switched on or off in the client record (Profile → “Print labels automatically”). It does not change existing clients.
ops.defaultsHint: These pre-select the fields in Quick and Detailed entry — operators can change them per shipment, but they don't start blank.
ops.maxStopsHint: Used for any driver without their own max set in Drivers & rates — you can set a per-driver exception there.
ops.pipelineHint: Which actions each shipment status allows (StatusCapability). The server enforces them on every operation; without a company rule the platform rule applies (allowed if there is none).
ops.pipelineReadOnly: Read-only: changing the matrix requires the admin.statusconfig permission.
ops.pipelineNoAccess: Your user cannot read the status pipeline.
ops.recvSumHint: Read-only. The mode is changed in each warehouse (Warehouses → Receiving), because the receiving area is physical. With putaway: goods enter the receiving location and are put away afterwards. Direct: the receiver picks the final location and there is no putaway. A warehouse with putaway needs a receiving location in order to receive.
ops.recvNoAccess: Your user cannot read the warehouses.
ops.productCategoryHelp: When a product is created from the Products screen it arrives with this category already chosen; it can be changed or cleared there. It does not affect existing products or those that come in through an import or the API.
ops.rotationHelp: Which stock leaves first when the system assigns an issue (picking, manual issue, replenishment and the device exit order). FEFO: first expired, first out (as always). FIFO: first in, first out, by the stock balance first-entry date. A product can have its own exception on its record. It applies from the next assignment; it does not change what was already picked.
ops.rotationSuggest: Suggest: proposed and can be changed
ops.receiptRequirementHelp: Free: you can receive blind or by manual return (as always). The other values block receiving without a document and require receiving against a client arrival notice, a purchase order or either. Receipts from a sales return are not affected.
ops.valuationHelp: Average cost: the cost of each issue and the inventory value come from the weighted average of what was received. By layers: first in, first out, and what remains is valued with the newest layers. Based on the cost frozen on each receipt (purchase order, arrival notice price or product cost).
ops.requirementHelp: Free: you can dispatch without a document (as always). The other values block manual dispatch without a document and require dispatching from an exit notice, a sales order or either. Packing is not affected.
ops.rotationEnforcementLabel: How it is applied on issues
ops.rotationEnforcementHelp: Suggest: when issuing, the system proposes the position and lot the method calls for; the person issuing can change them and the screen warns that the rotation is being skipped. Enforce: the system picks alone and splits the quantity across positions and lots; nobody can choose a position or lot, and the server rejects any other. It applies to picking and manual issue, on the web and on the warehouse device; transfers and adjustments are not affected.
ops.rotationPosition: By position — by zone and position code
ops.rotationNoLotLabel: Company rotation method (products without lot or serials)
ops.rotationNoLotHelp: Products without lot and serial-tracked ones do not expire, so there is no FEFO. FIFO (the default for them from now on): what came in first goes out first. By position: it comes from the position that is due by its zone and code, ignoring dates. A product can have its own exception on its record.
ops.invExpiryHelp: How many days ahead "Lots about to expire" warns (1 to 365; 30 by default).
ops.invIdleLabel: Warn about products with no movement for (days)
ops.invIdleHelp: After how many days without movements "Products with no movement" warns (1 to 3650; 90 by default).
ops.invExpiryRange: The expiry warning days must be between 1 and 365.
ops.invIdleRange: The days without movement must be between 1 and 3650.
ops.invAlertsHint: Every day at 6:00 the system checks the inventory. Who receives each alert (lots about to expire, expired lots, products below minimum, out of stock and no movement) is set in System → Notification rules.
ops.fleetDocHelp: How many days ahead "Fleet documents about to expire" warns (1 to 365; 30 by default).
ops.fleetDocRange: The fleet document warning days must be between 1 and 365.
ops.fleetAlertsHint: Every day at 6:15 the system checks vehicle and driver documents and preventive maintenance. Who receives each alert (documents about to expire, expired documents, maintenance coming up and overdue) is set in System → Notification rules.
ops.manualReasonHelp: It comes preselected when issuing; the reason is still required.
ops.countRevealTitle: Cycle count: expected quantity while counting
ops.countRevealLabel: Who sees the expected quantity while counting?

countRevealHelp.NONE: Nobody sees the expected quantity while counting in the app, not even the supervisor. Reconciling on the web still shows it.
countRevealHelp.MARKED: Only counters marked «Yes» in Users see it, after capturing each line.
countRevealHelp.ALL: All counters see it after capturing each line, except those marked «No» in Users.

ops.countTolLabel: Margin before asking for a recount (%)
ops.countTolHelp: 0 = any difference asks for a recount. With 5, a quantity within 5 % of the expected one is accepted.
ops.countTolRange: The margin must be between 0 and 100 %.
ops.countNumberText: Show the number (otherwise just «Matches» or «Does not match»)
ops.countNumberHelp: Outside the margin the expected quantity is never shown: a recount is requested. The number is only seen on a match or after recounting.
ops.countAutoCloseText: When a count that matches is finished, confirm it automatically
ops.countAutoCloseHelp: Off: every finished count waits for someone to confirm it (or use “Close the ones that match”). On: if, when the count is finished, every line is counted and nothing needs adjusting against the current stock, it ends as Match without going through the web. Counts with a difference still wait for review.
ops.countRevealHint: With «Only marked users» or «Everybody», whoever has the «Count» permission (supervisor) sees the expected quantity from the start. The counter (only «Capture count») sees it after accepting each line; outside the margin a recount is requested and the line closes. With «Nobody» nobody sees it while counting in the app.

readers.name: Reader {n} name

readers.firstOnlyHelp: If several that meet it arrive, this reader takes only the first.
readers.clientHelp: The client of what this reader reads. Empty = the integration's.
readers.templateHelp: This reader's import template. Empty = the integration's.
readers.whenHelp: Conditions (all must be met). With no conditions, this reader takes everything of its source.
readers.fileHelp: A data file (CSV, Excel, JSON or XML) is read with the integration's template and format; it has no fields to read.

email.bodyHelp: Each field goes to a column of the integration's import template: the body becomes a file row (or several, with a block of lines) and the same template reads it.
email.columnHelp: Which template column (1, 2, 3…) this value goes to.
email.label: Label {n}
email.labelHelp: The text before the value, without the colon.
email.patternHelp: The value is the first group in parentheses (or the whole match).
email.separatorHelp: A space = long gaps or tabs.
email.lineRegexHelp: Every line of the block that matches is a row and the groups in parentheses (1, 2, 3…) go to the columns below (“6=1” = template position 6 takes group 1). Lines that do not match are ignored (continuations, dashes, totals). With it, start and end are not needed. In a PDF, columns are separated by a tab.
email.repeat: Repeat the block on every page of field {n}
email.repeatHelp: Read it every time the start text appears (the table header repeated on each PDF page), not only the first. It needs the start text.

errors.port: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
errors.mailbox: Enter the mailbox folder to read (e.g. INBOX).
errors.noFields: With "read the body" enter at least one field to read.
errors.position: The column must be between 1 and 500.
errors.label: Enter the label to look for in the email.
errors.block: A block needs the start and end text.
errors.blockColumns: A block needs at least one column (position and line column number).
errors.regex: The per-line regular expression is not valid.
errors.repeatStart: To repeat the block, enter the start text (the repeated header).
errors.readerNameDuplicate: There is already a reader with that name.
errors.readerFields: A body or PDF reader needs at least one field to read.
errors.conditionScope: That condition does not apply to what this reader reads.
errors.nameFilter: With "by name" enter the attachment name condition.
errors.senders: An allowed sender is not a valid email or domain.

remote.sectionHelp: Teikem connects to the server, downloads the new files from the folder, processes them with the template and MOVES them to "procesados" (or "errores"). It never deletes anything.
remote.secretHelp: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
remote.secretKept: Leave empty to keep the saved one.
remote.dirHelp: Where the client drops the files (e.g. /entrada).
remote.processedHelp: Inside the remote folder, or a full path starting with /. Empty = files stay where they are (the hash prevents processing them twice).

errors.port: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
errors.dir: Enter the remote folder where files arrive.
errors.dirInvalid: Folders cannot contain ".." or line breaks.
errors.fingerprint: The fingerprint must be the server SHA-256 (SHA256:… in base64).
errors.keyOnlySftp: The private key is only used with SFTP.

remote.fingerprintHelp: Required for SFTP: without it nothing connects. Use "Test connection", compare the fingerprint it shows with the provider's and paste it here.
remote.useFtpsHelp: Without FTPS the user, password and files travel in clear text. Use it whenever the server supports it.
remote.typesHelp: Extensions separated by commas (csv, txt). Files modified less than 10 s ago wait for the next run.

inbox.title: Integrations inbox
inbox.noAccess: You do not have access to the integrations inbox.
inbox.emptyPending: Nothing is pending: everything that came in was processed.
inbox.help: A shipment with problems is never created halfway: it stays here with its reason. Fix the data and reprocess; raw data is purged after the integration's retention days.
inbox.fixHelp: These are the rows as they arrived. Fix the cells that need it and use "Save and reprocess".
inbox.noData: This item's data is no longer kept (retention passed or the file could not be read): discard it and ask for the file again.
inbox.stillPending: It still has problems; check the reason.

entityImport.title: Import {entity}
entityImport.help: Upload a file (CSV or Excel) and pick the template that says which column is each field. “Review” saves nothing; “Import” creates the valid records. Create-only: anything that already exists is rejected, never updated.

PRODUCT.sku: The template must include the sku column.
PRODUCT.name: The template must include the name column or a default value for name.

SUPPLIER.name: The template must include the name column.

WAREHOUSE.code: The template must include the code column.
WAREHOUSE.name: The template must include the name column.

BIN.warehouse: The template must include the warehouseCode column or a default value for warehouseCode.
BIN.zone: The template must include the zoneCode column or a default value for zoneCode.
BIN.code: The template must include the code column or the bin part columns (aisle, rack, level, position).

templates.title: Templates
templates.subtitle: How the files of each entity are read (column → field). The same templates serve the Import wizard and integrations.
templates.empty: There are no templates for this entity yet.
templates.noPermission: You need the {perm} permission to view and change these templates.

jobs.title: Scheduled jobs
jobs.subtitle: the company's automatic tasks: when they run, how they went, and "Run now"
jobs.help: Jobs run on their own at their time; if the system was off at that time they run when it comes back. If one fails it is retried soon (1, 2 and 5 minutes) before going back to its normal schedule.
jobs.runRequested: "{name}" will run in a few seconds.

errors.interval: The interval must be between 60 seconds and 7 days (604800).
errors.dailyInvalid: The daily time is not valid; use HH:mm (24 hours).

jobs.docReady: The document is ready to print.
jobs.withoutNumber: {n} pieces without a package number were not printed.
jobs.withoutInvoice: {n} shipments without an invoice number get no invoice label.
jobs.none: There are no labels to print.
jobs.large: That is {n} labels: the PDF will be large and may take a moment. All are printed; there is no limit.
jobs.afterSaveFailed: The shipment was saved, but its label could not be printed: {reason}. Use “Print label” on the shipment.

printing.title: Printers & labels
printing.subtitle: Printer and template per station
printing.perStationNote: The label printer and the document printer are configured separately, and each workstation keeps its own configuration.
printing.notFit: The label does not fit on {size}: remove elements or use a bigger label.

outcome.download: The PDF was downloaded to print it.
outcome.qzNoLibrary: Direct printing is not available on this computer (QZ Tray or its library is missing).
outcome.qzNotRunning: QZ Tray is not running on this computer.

test.docBody: If you can read this whole page, the document printer of this station is ready.

station.label: This station — labels
station.systemPrinterHelp: Exact name of the printer on this computer; QZ Tray prints by that name.
station.systemPrinterDetect: Use “Detect printers on this computer” above to pick it from the list.
station.printerInactive: The printer chosen on this station is no longer active: the company default is used.
station.templateInactive: The template chosen on this station is no longer active: the company default is used.
station.perClient: Printing the label and the invoice when a shipment is created is set per client: in the client record → Profile.
station.onSaveOn: The company prints labels directly when a shipment is saved: with “Print on save” off, this station does not print them.
station.onSaveOff: The company has “Print labels directly to the printer” off: saving a shipment does not print its label.
station.viaQz: Prints directly with QZ Tray on “{name}”.
station.viaBrowser: Prints with the browser PDF (no printer configured).
station.storageFailed: This browser did not allow saving the station configuration.

builder.title: Build the label
builder.invoiceHint: The invoice label prints once per shipment, after the package labels, for clients with «Invoice label» turned on. By default it is the barcode of the invoice number with the number right under it, centered; add anything else you need (client, consignee, COD…) and move or resize it.
builder.hint: Pick which elements appear on the label, their position and size — the preview updates live. The barcode is each package's number: one label prints per package.
builder.needsBarcode: The label needs at least one barcode so it can be scanned.
builder.name: Template name

qz.title: This computer — direct printing
qz.connectedHelp: Printers with the “Direct (QZ Tray)” connection print without a dialog on this computer.
qz.noLibrary: Direct printing is not available on this computer: QZ Tray or its library is missing. The browser PDF is used.
qz.notRunning: QZ Tray is not running on this computer: open (or install) it and detect again. Meanwhile the browser PDF is used.
qz.unsigned: The server has no QZ Tray certificate: QZ Tray will ask “Allow” when printing.

company.title: Company settings
company.direct: Print labels directly to the printer
company.directHelp: On: saving a shipment (quick or detailed entry) prints one label per package on the label printer of the station, without a dialog if the station has QZ Tray. Off: labels are printed by hand.
company.on: Labels will print directly when shipments are saved.
company.off: Labels no longer print by themselves when shipments are saved.

printer.title: Company printers
printer.name: Name
printer.nameHelp: Best if it matches the name of the printer in Windows or macOS.
printer.purposeFixed: The use cannot change; create another printer for another use.
printer.connectionHelp: Direct (QZ Tray) prints without a dialog on computers that have QZ Tray; otherwise the browser PDF opens.
printer.systemNameHelp: The exact name of the printer on the computer (empty = the name above). Use “Detect printers” to pick it.
printer.rotateHelp: For printers that feed the label sideways.
printer.empty: The company has no printers: printing uses the browser PDF.
printer.madeDefault: “{name}” is now the default for its use.
printer.deactivateBody: “{name}” stops being offered on the stations. You can reactivate it later.
printer.deactivateDefaultBody: “{name}” is the default: once deactivated its use has no default (stations without their own printer print with the browser PDF) until you pick another.
